products.name: Phasor
products.tagline: exact stores with one-pass operators for .NET
products.pitch: Build stores that answer exactly, replicas that sync by their differences and tables that repair themselves. One pass applies a thousand operators.

products.name: EvalApp
products.tagline: a self-tuning async pipeline runtime for .NET
products.pitch: Run everything at once without overloading anything. Gates on every resource, sagas that undo failures, and a tuner that finds the right speed.

products.name: HoloDb
products.pitch: An embedded SQL database that learns from the queries it serves and keeps only what pays. Every answer is exact, with ACID and no index to design.

products.name: AlgFormer
products.tagline: small language models in one shared wave, for .NET
products.pitch: A population of small holographic language models that talk through a shared wave, in pure managed code.

products.name: Prose
products.pitch: Three novels in, nearly two thousand checked new sentences out. Mines grammar into HoloDb and recombines it into text and question and answer pairs.

products.name: HoloGenome
products.tagline: DNA as a hologram of measured helix physics for .NET
products.pitch: Turn DNA into a vector that winds like the real helix, then check it against laboratory measurements it never saw. The wins and the losses are published.

products.name: Tracer
products.pitch: Send a whole crowd to one exit with a single search. Navmesh pathfinding with dynamic obstacles, line of sight and combat.

products.name: HoloVoxel
products.pitch: Voxel worlds that stay crisp up close and cost almost nothing far away, with no mesh tiers and no popping.

products.name: Blazier
products.tagline: lazy Blazor WebAssembly for static hosts
products.pitch: Blazor pages that read at once and download .NET only when a visitor presses Start, with long C# jobs in a Web Worker.
